answer: A Sybil-resistant economy grants voting weight only from non-transferable reputation earned in audited trades of scarce goods like ivory, pigment, and pulse. Each deal is signed by a unique key, so splitting one trusted account into many cannot copy its history: every forged identity must first surrender real inventory to build standing. The attacker pays full goods value for each fake agent, and shared counterparties expose the cluster, so all its bonds get slashed.
